direction: Validate the seeded 127-leaf LightGBM Tweedie AllState champion through a structurally different direct pure-premium loss specification. Start with LightGBM squared-error using the allowed native categorical representation, then use observed comparison results to decide whether one targeted robust alternative is justified. Do not spend cycles on another shallow-capacity sweep.
starting_knowledge: In d02, native-categorical LightGBM Tweedie at 63 leaves achieved gini 0.0381 versus the flat baseline.
A 31-leaf, 0.03-learning-rate variant was decisively worse (gini 0.0111); capacity matters.
Expanding to 127 leaves improved the d02 champion to gini 0.0488 with calibration ratio about 0.968.
constraints: Use declarative recipes only; do not write custom scripts.
Stay within direct pure-premium framing and use only named eligible features.
The first proposal must be a genuine loss/objective comparison against the seeded Tweedie champion, not a capacity retune.
If the alternative is clearly inferior, use remaining cycles for one materially different validation only; do not tune the losing objective repeatedly.
success_criteria: Either beat the seeded 127-leaf Tweedie champion with clean calibration, or establish an evidence-backed reason to retain Tweedie before final consolidation.
